messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-prompt-medium-0145", "row_sha256": "cfa7761a0709cc747a0a44ac2c645351b81f64f681bc8510be0ed6f9f510b0b1", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "
can you make these notes into a clear update for the customer about their dishwasher warranty claim? keep it factual and don't make it sound like coverage has been decided. the unit is a Northline DW-440, bought at Harbor Home on May 18, 2024, with warranty through May 18, 2026. registration matches serial NL44-90817. claim opened feb 6, 2026 after water showed up under the front left side after a cycle. service visit was feb 11. the technician found a split inlet hose and saw no damage to the cabinet or floor; they didn't test a replacement hose. homeowner says the dishwasher stayed installed and hadn't been moved. receipt was uploaded feb 7 and the service report came in feb 12. please mention those dates and what has been received, but don't imply the review is finished. the assessment is that the split hose may qualify if it resulted from a manufacturing defect. damage from improper installation, external impact, or freezing is excluded. the inspection notes do not establish what caused the split, so the warranty team still needs to review it. if the cause is confirmed as a covered materials or workmanship defect, the possible coverage is limited to the inlet hose and related replacement labor. don't include floor repair in that scope; no floor damage was observed or assessed. organize the update so the claim facts and current assessment are easy to tell apart, and end with the pending-review status.", "output": "Write a clear, factual customer update about the dishwasher warranty claim. Keep the claim facts separate from the current assessment, and do not imply that coverage has been decided or that the review is complete.

**Claim facts:** The appliance is a Northline DW-440, purchased at Harbor Home on May 18, 2024. Its warranty runs through May 18, 2026, and the registration matches serial NL44-90817. The claim was opened February 6, 2026, after water appeared under the front-left side following a cycle. During the February 11 service visit, the technician found a split inlet hose and observed no damage to the cabinet or floor. The technician did not test a replacement hose. The homeowner says the dishwasher remained installed and had not been moved. The receipt was uploaded February 7, and the service report was received February 12.

**Current assessment:** The inspection notes do not establish what caused the hose to split, so the warranty team still needs to review the claim. The split hose may qualify if it resulted from a manufacturing defect. Damage caused by improper installation, external impact, or freezing is excluded. If the cause is confirmed as a covered materials or workmanship defect, possible coverage is limited to the inlet hose and related replacement labor. Floor repair is not within that scope; no floor damage was observed or assessed.

End by stating that the review is still pending."}]
